assessments.reasoning: Authenticity: publisher_live is Creative Commons' own /publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt. Integrity: its reported [5884,6024) digest matches the citation and its whole-file digest matches publisher_pin and the scoped revision. Relevance: [5884,6024) contains the operative section 4(a). Interpretation: “licensed or otherwise affected by this document” covers the fallback alongside the clause's express waiver exclusions. Applicability: the Statement of Purpose identifies the Affirmer applying CC0 to a Work, and 4(a) specifies the holder and both right types. Contradiction: sections 2 and 3 operate on the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights, 1(iv) expressly defers to 4(a), and 4(c) leaves third-party clearance a separate matter.

limitations: The finding concerns the effect of this instrument on the Affirmer's rights. Separate grants, defenses, ownership and third-party clearances require separate evidence.
reasoning: When an Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work, section 4(a) expressly preserves patent and trademark rights “held by Affirmer”. Its verbs cover both relinquishment under section 2 and licensing under section 3. Section 4(c) separately addresses clearance of rights held by others.
